title: GoldSalvage
description: Salvage your gold tools and armor for some extra gold ingots!
body:
This datapack adds simple crafting recipes to turn gold tools and armor back into gold ingots. You can salvage your gold items by putting them in the crafting table to receive majority of the gold ingots you used to make the tool.

Helmet -> 3 gold ingots

Chestplate -> 5 gold ingots

Leggings -> 4 gold ingots

Boots -> 2 gold ingots

Sword -> 1 gold ingot

Pickaxe -> 2 gold ingots

Axe -> 2 gold ingots

Shovel -> 2 sticks (to prevent infinite recycling of shovels)

Hoe -> 1 gold ingot
